Cada punto es una detección satelital de: Each point is a satellite heat detection. It may indicate a controlled burn, a wildfire, industrial heat, or another source. Confirmation requires verification.
El índice se expresa en celdas-día MODIS: The index is expressed in MODIS-equivalent cell-days. It is a relative measure of thermal activity and does not measure burned hectares or the official number of wildfires.
La escala mensual es solo indicativa (er: The monthly scale is indicative (approximately 40% error). Use the quarterly or annual scale for comparisons.
Una alerta es una señal estadística rela: An alert is a statistical signal relative to the history of the same month. It requires verification and does not confirm a wildfire.
La probabilidad es aproximada y sale de: The probability is approximate and comes from a model fitted with about 13 years of data. Equivalent years are indicative and should not be presented as “once every N years”.
Mapas con límites del parque, municipios: Maps with park, municipality, or district boundaries
Los límites del parque, municipios y dis: Park, municipality, and district boundaries come from open reference sources (OpenStreetMap and ciudatoslab). Validate them with GAMC and SERNAP before institutional use. GAMC-derived areas carry a separate notice.
La fuente es un servicio oficial del GAM: The source is an official GAMC service. The geometry was derived from an image for Cota 2750 (about 11 m sampling, positional accuracy not assessed) or a GetFeatureInfo query for peri-urban areas. Redistribution terms are unconfirmed. The geometry is unsuitable as a legal boundary.
Suomi-NPP y NOAA-20 pasan por el mismo l: Suomi-NPP and NOAA-20 pass over the same place less than an hour apart. A single fire may appear as two satellite detections, so counting detection rows can count it twice. The comparable unit is the cell-day.
Las alertas entregadas se calculan solo: The published alerts use VIIRS Suomi-NPP only. It stopped producing new observations in early November 2026 (FIRMS indicates coverage through November 2, 2026). NOAA-20 is comparable in monthly totals. A proposed link requires verification with 2026 data.
Índice armonizado de un polígono dibujad: Harmonized index for a drawn polygon or new area
El índice usa los factores del catálogo: The index uses satellite catalog factors calibrated in Tunari. They are approximate elsewhere (MODIS to VIIRS is 2.87 in Tunari and 2.09 for Bolivia). MODIS rarely detects small polygons, so their index is noisy. Loaded data cover only the park and municipality. If pct_area_con_datos is 0 (sin_cobertura = true), data are unavailable. Partial coverage represents only the covered part. Always display aviso. A drawn polygon uses metodo_indice = viirs_reescalado (VIIRS / factor, no comparable value before February 2012), even when it overlaps Tunari. The calibrated mixed method is exclusive to the registered parque-tunari area.
Calendario, series e índice de cualquier: Calendar, series and index for any area
Cada mes del índice trae calidad_indice:: Each month has a calidad_indice code: calibrado_localmente_en_tunari (the locally calibrated Tunari National Park, with about 40% monthly error), aproximado_factor_transferido (VIIRS rescaled using the Tunari factor without local validation), or no_comparable (no comparable value outside Tunari before February 2012). Show transferred values with a notice and unavailable values in gray without assigning zero. The structural bounds show sensitivity to the factor.
Esta celda tiene detecciones en la mayor: This cell has detections in most years, at night and at low power. A stationary heat source could explain the pattern. Verification is required.
La serie mensual, el índice y las alerta: The monthly series, index, and alerts extend through October 31, 2026. NRT detections (origen_dato = NRT) are provisional, are reprocessed by NASA, and lack a detection type. Suomi-NPP stopped providing new observations in early November 2026 (FIRMS indicates coverage through November 2, 2026).
La búsqueda solo cubre el Parque Naciona: The search covers only Tunari National Park and the municipality of Cochabamba. Data are unavailable outside these areas.
La validación usa siete incendios public: Validation uses seven wildfires reported by the press without coordinates. Spatial and field validation are unavailable.
